Menon Monday, The 10Th Day Of March 2025 / 19Th Phalguna, 1946 Wp(C) No. 2463 Of 2019 Petitioner: Santhosh Paul Aged 52 Years, S/O Paul, Kizhakkebhagam House, Cherupoyl, Nilambur Railway Station Po, Nilambur Taluk, Malappuram District. By Advs. Sri.P.Samsudin Sri.K.C.Antony Mathew Sri.Jithin Lukose Respondents: 1 Food Safety Assistant Commissioner Malappuram, Office Of The Food Safety Assistant Commissioner, Malappuram-676505. 2 Food Safety Officer, Nilambur Block, Chandakkunnu, Nilambur Po-679329, Malappuram District. 3 The District Collector, Malappuram, Civil Station, Malappuram-676505. By Advs. Sri.Grashious Kuriakose, Addl.Director General Of Prosecution(Ag-11) Sri.E.G.Gorden, Sr.Gp. 2 W.P.(C) No.2463 of 2019 Santhosh Paul vs Food Safety Assistant Commissioner ... on 10 March, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101337640/ 1 2025:Ker:20015 This Writ Petition (Civil) Having Come Up For Admission On 10.03.2025, The Court On The Same Day Delivered The Following: 3 W.P.(C) No.2463 of 2019 2025:Ker:20015 Judgment
texts.facts: The petitioner has filed the captioned writ petition, seeking to challenge the action taken by respondents in locking and sealing building No.18/1 in Amarambalam Panchayat. The petitioner has sought for a direction to the 2nd respondent to remove the lock and seal and to permit the petitioner to occupy the building in question and to do business therein.
texts.arguments: He would point out that only the room in question, wherein the disputed articles were kept, was locked. He further points out that the proceedings initiated on the basis of the seizure with reference to the provisions of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, have already been finalised against the petitioner, imposing a penalty of Rs.5,000/-, which however, has not been paid by the petitioner. Sri.Samsudin, on the other hand, would point out that, no such order has ever been served on the petitioner.
